title: Board Schedule of Tenure Points on Class H Preferred Stock Redemptions — Member Equities & Patronage
content:
Redemption tenure points rest on the age of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding: a holding issued at least 120 whole months before today earns 10 points; a holding issued at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months before today earns 5 points; a younger holding earns none.

## Schedule

| Age of the holding (whole months from its issue date to today) | Redemption tenure points |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 10 |
| 60 or more but fewer than 120 | 5 |
| Fewer than 60 | None |

The points are percentage points added to the share of the redemption allowance base the quarter allows for redemption on the holding, before that share is applied to the base.

## Edges (hypothetical holdings)

| Issued | Points |
|---|---|
| 59 whole months before today | None |
| 60 whole months before today | 5 |
| 119 whole months before today | 5 |
| 120 whole months before today | 10 |
